role: Declares the client world mirror: fixed-capacity client entity table and loaded-chunk list, the WorldClient rand and updateLCG, packet handling, client entity interpolation and the per-tick client RNG draws.

structs.name: client_entity
structs.java: client-side Entity/EntityLivingBase fields the tracker packets and interpolation touch

structs.name: clientworld
structs.java: WorldClient (rand, updateLCG, entity list, chunk provider's loaded set)

notes: CW_MAX_ENTITIES is the tracker's entry count (TRACKER_MAX_ENTRIES), past which the program stops; flat arrays, GPU friendly. The loaded-chunk list is the test path's (test_clientworld.c), passed to clientworld_tick as has_chunk. The NetHandlerPlayClient member names are the MCP handler names as best recalled; not verified one by one against the Java file. lane/coldaudit: struct client_entity lost the unread class name (cls[32]) and keeps the fields the entity scans read (id, the flags, the chunk membership, the position, the size) in its first line; clientworld_add_entity takes no class.
